Name: Confirm Mine Ladder
Author: emurphy42
Description:
This mod affects the confirmation interface (if any) before leaving a mine level.

Options:
[list]
[*][b]None[/b]: Use the ladder/shaft immediately, no confirmation needed.
[*][b]Dialog[/b]: Yes/no confirmation (default yes). This is the mod's default behavior.
[*][b]Warning[/b]: More intrusive yes/no confirmation (default no).
[/list]
Things that this affects:
[list]
[*]Leave the mine (return to entrance).
[*]Go down one level. (Base game doesn't ask for confirmation.)
[*]Jump into a shaft.
[/list]
This doesn't affect the mine entrance, the elevator, or anything in the volcano dungeon.

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/emurphy42/ConfirmMineLadder]Source code[/url]
[/list]
